_readme: Single source for the portfolio (/projects). Edit here, then run: node build-portfolio.cjs. status must be one of: Completed, In Progress, Design Development. Never mark renders as Completed. area: only verified figures, else null. imageKind: photo | render.

projects.name: Casa Bianca
projects.summary: The family called it the White House: a neoclassical farmhouse with around ten bedrooms and an eight-shaped pool, built through 45°C summers on a remote site.
projects.alt: Casa Bianca, a white neoclassical farmhouse in Sohna, seen across the front lawn

projects.name: Hotel Silk by Resham
projects.summary: A food-led highway destination given 23 guest rooms, designed and built for hard daily use and low running costs.
projects.alt: Lobby seating area at Hotel Silk by Resham, Murthal

projects.name: The Dholpur Stone Villa
projects.summary: A hand-built stone house with no columns or beams, replanned for modern family life and Vastu without losing its Dholpur facade.
projects.alt: Dholpur stone facade of the 35-year-old villa in Narela

projects.name: Mini Farmhouse
projects.summary: A compact farmhouse built on restraint, where layout, light and proportion do the work instead of ornament.
projects.alt: Exterior of the Mini Farmhouse in Delhi

projects.name: South Delhi Neo-Classical Residence
projects.summary: Classic mouldings and panelled walls in a compact 2 BHK, with wardrobes built into the panelling so the flat stays calm.
projects.alt: Living room of the South Delhi Neo-Classical Residence with panelled walls

projects.name: DDA Apartment
projects.summary: A DDA flat where storage was solved on the plan first, then light, then material, with a fluted-wood breakfast bar off the kitchen.
projects.alt: Grey lacquered modular kitchen with backlit open shelving, DDA Apartment, Delhi

projects.name: Vasant Kunj DDA Residence
projects.summary: A DDA home designed room by room: a completed parents' bedroom in Indian heritage joinery, with the living and dining room, kitchen, powder washroom and a modern bedroom now in design development.
projects.alt: Parents' bedroom with a Rajasthani-inspired mural and cane headboard, Vasant Kunj DDA Residence

projects.name: Studio Workspace
projects.summary: A workplace planned around daylight and sustained focus, with a conference room, cafeteria and open studio floor.
projects.alt: Main studio floor of a 3,200 sq ft office in Gurgaon

projects.name: Patel Nagar Menswear Store
projects.summary: A two-floor menswear store being rebuilt around a younger customer.
projects.alt: Ground floor of the Patel Nagar menswear store

projects.name: Indéva Studio Office
projects.summary: Our own studio and client meeting room: one compact room planned wall by wall for work, meetings and a material display.
projects.alt: Meeting table in the Indéva Studio office, Narela

projects.name: Bansal Residence
projects.summary: A ground-floor home being replanned around Vastu: mandir in the north-east, kitchen in the south-east and a ground-floor bedroom, with minimal structural change.
